rationale: The November 6 update marks Universal Forwarder unaffected and identifies bundled Enterprise 10.0 Node.js separately from 9.4 and 10.2+. Upgrade to 10.2+ addresses the bundled 10.0 runtime only. Visual Exporter stays affected with mitigation and remediation in progress. Automation Broker, Observability Cloud and Collector are affected with remediation in progress; Synthetic Runner has a separate 1.71.0+ recommendation.
